placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/coordination/ with its own contract unit, plus hub.ts, the optional SharedWorker relay the host serves. Messages are JSON, size-bounded and validated by the pack before an engine sees them; each engine decodes its own schema. Web Locks are coordination mechanics only: the pack never decides what holding a lock means, and leadership is the engine's. Frame messaging names an exact origin, never a wildcard, and accepts only messages from that frame at that origin. No shared mutable state: each context's engine keeps its own. Core unchanged; absent unless registered. The smoke runner gains second-page actions and per-page frame policies.
